svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 05 · Los Angeles · 02/12 Powell Library (Rare)
svg.desc: Royce’s partner across the quad. Step inside, look up at the ceiling, then find a seat. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
